context: Daichi tries to fix a broken washing machine; Kenji stops by to help.
purpose: Two men troubleshooting an appliance together.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 洗濯機、故障してもうた。
lines.style: Weary, matter-of-fact opening. Warm resignation in the voice—not complaining, just stating the obvious problem. Small, tired exhale. Kansai lilt throughout, grounded and honest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Gentle diagnostic question. Leans in slightly with focus. Warm and attentive—like he's already thinking through it with you. Kansai cadence, unhurried and steady.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: うん、うんともすんとも。
lines.style: Flat, exhausted confirmation. No life in it. Slight frustrated edge but mostly just tired. Kansai drawl on the affirmation. Trailing off into defeat.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Practical, grounded suggestion. Warm problem-solver tone—no drama, just moving forward. Kansai softness underneath. Light, actionable delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Urgent, pointing attention. Quick and a little sharp with frustration. Genuine—not performing, just need him to see the problem. Kansai directness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yeah, that'll need a part replacement.
lines.style: Composed diagnosis. Quiet confidence—he's seen this before. Matter-of-fact but warm, not condescending. Kansai steadiness. Clean, clear delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Thanks—I'll go to the shop today.
lines.style: Grateful and determined. Soft warmth underneath the resolve. Kansai gratitude—genuine, not performative. Rolling up sleeves in the voice. Moving to action.
